onset.Description: Onset of the event, measured from the beginning of the acquisition.

duration.Description: Duration of the event (measured from onset).

session.Description: session names as pXX for postnatal date

center_in.Description: time (relative to session start) when mouse pokes in center port to start a new trial

center_out.Description: time (relative to session start) when mouse leaves the center port

side_in.Description: time (relative to session start) when mouse pokes in side port

outcome.Description: time (relative to session start) of the outcome

zeroth_side_out.Description: time (relative to session start) when mouse triggers first IR beam after outcome

first_side_out.Description: time (relative to session start) when mouse leaves the side port for the first time after outcome

last_side_out.Description: time (relative to session start) right before mouse pokes in center port to start a new trial

prebswitch_num.Description: number of trials prior to block switch

tmax.Description: max time (relative to session start) in session

nwb_table.Description: The name of the NWB table from which this event was extracted.

Levels.trials: The 'trials' table in the NWB file.
